# SEO-451: Make every hreflang cluster reciprocal and self-referential

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Each page in a locale set lists every member of that set including itself, and each page it names lists it back, so no member of the cluster points outward without a return declaration.

## Rationale

A one-directional annotation is discarded rather than partially honoured, so a cluster with one missing return link loses the association for the whole set rather than for one page.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "multilingual"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Generate the whole annotation set from one locale table shared by every page in the cluster, rather than letting each template emit the alternates it happens to know about. Emit the self reference from the same loop that emits the others.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Fetch every page in each locale cluster, build the directed graph of declared alternates, and report members missing a self reference or a return edge.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`, `SITEMAP`
- Automated check: `hreflang-reciprocity`

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: Editing cluster membership changes which locale is served to which audience, so the change is reviewed rather than applied automatically even though the defect is mechanical.
